experiment_capture.config_scope: validation/model options + immutable PipelineId preprocessing reference
experiment_capture.data_access_time: captured before scheduling; run.data_access_at records first immutable snapshot read boundary

metrics.definition: all-point interpolated precision envelope; global score-ranked per-class, per-image one-to-one greedy best IoU; absent-GT class undefined/excluded; not COCO 101-point/area/crowd mAP

provenance.scope: immutable images; whole-component train/validation/test; only validation evaluated

transform.normalization: RGB/255 then fixed mean0.5/std0.5 for CNN; pixel model RGB/255

warnings: Validation holdout only; final test unused; no independent general quality claim.
Pre-extracted video frames only; saliency not provided as causal explanation.
Model bbox/mask output is resized/cropped pixel coordinates; human annotation uses original EXIF-oriented pixels, never silently promoted.
Bounded RGB color classifier; bbox supervision weak. Not general YOLO/U-Net; no neural detection/segmentation quality guarantee.
